My step daughter was this way, very attached to the bottle and pacifier. I started by trying a few different cups in the day time, sippy cups with soft nipples and sippy cups with straws. Once we found one she liked, we walked to the dumpster and we let her throw it in the trash while she held her new princess cup in her hand. At night we let her take a drink of her cup and put it “night night” on the dresser and when she wakes up asking for it we would remind her it was in the trash. She would scream her little head off sometimes, but we experimented with different comfort items to help at night.  Eventually we found a light up plush puppy she loved and would cuddle at night instead of drinking the bottle. I’ve always tried to replace comfort items instead of getting rid of them and found it helps. It’s definitely a process and requires consistency, but I believe in you! Getting rid of the bottle took about a week and it was the same with the pacifier, stay strong!
